name: preflight-planning-branch-gap
title: Preflight skips the planning branch-null rule it reports checking
description: The default no-argument invocation of sd-ai-command-pack-review-preflight.mjs reports PASS on Trellis task branch integrity while never reaching the planning-lifecycle rule at :2266, so a status=planning task carrying a non-null branch exits 0 clean.
creator: sdelmas
